# Maryland Department of Health

> > Official health portal for Maryland, providing behavioral health services, mental health and substance use resources, disease surveillance, and community health programs.

The Maryland Department of Health operates multiple divisions including the Behavioral Health Administration (BHA) for mental health and addiction services, and surveillance systems like the Maryland Resident Influenza Tracking Survey (MRITS) for monitoring public health trends across the state.

## Key Topics

- Behavioral Health Administration (BHA)
- Mental health services
- Substance use disorder treatment
- Overdose prevention and data
- Community health services
- Influenza surveillance (MRITS)
- Maryland residents health tracking
- ILI (Influenza-like illness) monitoring
- Flu season monitoring
- Community-based health programs
- Public health data collection
- Maryland health resources

## Behavioral Health Services

- [Behavioral Health Administration Home](https://bha.health.maryland.gov/): BHA homepage for mental health & substance use services in Maryland

## Disease Surveillance & Monitoring

- [Maryland Resident Influenza Tracking Survey](https://flusurvey.health.maryland.gov/): MRITS homepage for tracking influenza & ILI among Maryland residents
